parameters.name: endTime
parameters.description: The end of the time range to query. This is a UNIX timestamp in seconds.

parameters.name: pageNum
parameters.description: The page number. The default value is 1.

parameters.name: pageSize
parameters.description: The number of entries to return on each page. The default value is 10.

parameters.name: startTime
parameters.description: The start of the time range to query. This is a UNIX timestamp in seconds.

parameters.name: type
parameters.description: The log type. Valid values: \`select\` (query logs) and \`push\` (write logs).
